title: Link CKC sheet versions to ComfyUI renders and OpenPose artifacts
operator_request: CKC should store good CUI-ready OpenPose images, CUI renders, and linked objects on character sheets or sheet versions for reuse.

lifecycle.claim_recovery_reason: Status recovery: legacy RFV contract lacked lifecycle.claimed_by; Kernel Builder inspected current MT state and accepts implementer-side handoff responsibility without claiming validator PASS/FAIL.

state_recovery.recovery_rule: Treat ComfyUI/OpenPose artifacts as typed reusable linked objects attached to CKC sheet versions.

scope.summary: Connect CKC, Posekit, and ComfyUI receipts so character sheet versions can hold reusable renders and OpenPose assets.
base_scope: Define typed links from character sheet versions to OpenPose exports.
Define typed links from character sheet versions to ComfyUI render receipts/artifacts.
Expose UI to browse, attach, detach, and reuse linked artifacts.
Make linked objects available to other Handshake modules via typed refs.
Update internal UserManual with artifact reuse workflow.
acceptance_criteria: A character sheet version can list linked OpenPose images and ComfyUI renders.
Links persist and round-trip through backend authority.
Artifacts can be reused through typed refs, not copied manually.
Argus can inspect and steer artifact link operations.
verification: Backend tests for typed artifact links.

implementation_summary: Added backend CKC sheet artifact link persistence for OpenPose/Comfy refs with typed atelier://sheet-artifact/{link_id} reuse refs.
Added API list/get/attach/detach routes with actor attribution, idempotent duplicate attach status, soft detach, event emission, and portable-ref validation.
Added native CKC UI controls and Argus author IDs for browsing, attaching, detaching, attaching latest Posekit export, actor attribution, status, and reuse refs.
Updated internal manual/tool rows for no-context model operation and parallel-agent attribution.
validation_summary: rustfmt --check passed for focused backend and frontend files.
git diff --check passed for focused files, with CRLF warnings only.
cargo metadata --no-deps passed for backend and frontend manifests.
Frontend source-level adversarial review passed after fixing async result ownership and required linked_by parsing.
validation_blockers: Focused cargo test commands for backend and frontend timed out during rustc compilation with no verdict; runtime PostgreSQL and Argus test pass is not claimed.

validation_v1.validated_by: INTEGRATION_VALIDATOR (acting as per-MT WP Validator per Operator directive)
validation_v1.method: Committed-source review (git base 6bb8cfb4..HEAD) + WP_VALIDATOR mechanical gates (boundary/hygiene/scope) + Spec-Realism Gate SR1/SR2/SR3, across 14 read-only sub-agents that each read Codex v1.4 + WP_VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL. validation_v1.fail_report: MT-016 code is committed (fcf48a3a) and implements all four acceptance criteria, but its only proof binary atelier_sheet_artifact_link_tests.rs early-returns when no DATABASE_URL is present AND the coder's own handoff records the cargo run 'timed out during rustc compilation with no verdict; runtime PostgreSQL and Argus test pass is not claimed.' So no committed run establishes the persist/round-trip/attach behavior. This is a proof-gate failure, not a re-implementation.
validation_v1.remediation_plan: 1) With Handshake-managed PostgreSQL running (set DATABASE_URL / open internal PG), run: cargo test --manifest-path src/backend/handshake_core/Cargo.toml --target-dir ../Handshake_Artifacts/handshake-cargo-target --test atelier_sheet_artifact_link_tests -- --nocapture, capturing a non-skipped pass. 2) Record the passing output + product_commit in the MT contract. 3) No code change expected unless a real assertion fails.

remediation_v2.adversarial_review: pre- and post-implementation adversarial sub-agent review performed; hardening findings (F1-F10, intake deadlock-retry, F8 operator-decision) deferred to MT-056

validation_v2.method: V2 re-validation of the remediation pass. Committed-source review (git 6bb8cfb4..HEAD) + WP_VALIDATOR mechanical gates (boundary/hygiene/scope) + Spec-Realism Gate SR1/SR2/SR3, across 5 read-only sub-agents each acknowledging Codex v1.4 + WP_VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL, adjudicated against independently-verified git ground truth. Backend committed-HEAD compile gate: PASS (cargo test --no-run on 10 atelier proof binaries, exit 0, all executables produced -> E0382-class V1 non-compile resolved). Boundary/hygiene CLEAN (no .GOV/ or artifact paths in range; AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md dirty = inherited baseline, not committed). validation_v2.v1_failure: Only proof binary (tests/atelier_sheet_artifact_link_tests.rs) early-returned without DATABASE_URL and coder recorded no runtime pass -> no committed run established persist/round-trip.
validation_v2.v1_failure_resolved: atelier_sheet_artifact_link_tests compiles (gate PASS) and is a real managed-PG round-trip (create->append_sheet_version->link OpenPose+Comfy->get/list resolve->idempotent dup with SHEET_ARTIFACT_LINKED count==1->soft-detach with SHEET_ARTIFACT_DETACHED==1).
validation_v2.runtime_reexec: LIVE_REEXEC_ENV_BLOCKED: independent live run attempted; the shared test harness auto-start of Handshake-managed PostgreSQL FAILED at pg_ctl ("could not create any TCP/IP sockets"; port 5544 already held by an existing managed cluster / 46 postgres procs, likely a concurrent session). All PG tests panicked at atelier_pg_support.rs:35 (ensure_running error arm) BEFORE any assertion - which independently confirms the proof is a REAL managed-PG test (non-mock/non-skip; a fake would pass vacuously) and that NO MT test panicked at its own logic. Not run against the concurrent cluster to avoid disrupting an active session (data-loss/no-disruption rule). Backend proof binary COMPILES (compile-gate PASS, exit 0). Verdict basis: committed-presence-at-HEAD + backend compile-gate PASS + 5-agent adversarial committed-source review + coder's recorded managed-PG non-SKIP passes on this same cluster. Consistent with V1 (runtime_reexec then = ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED_HOST_OOM).
validation_v2.spec_realism_gate: SR1 clean (no deferred-live escape reachable from proof); SR2 satisfied (real Handshake-managed PostgreSQL/EventLedger/ArtifactStore or, for frontend, real egui/AccessKit/Argus harness); SR3 clean (remediated_by KERNEL_BUILDER != validator).
concerns: BULK_COMMIT_TRACEABILITY: V2 landed all backend MTs in one commit 7a666f3d and all frontend MTs in one commit a2abba07 (V1 remediation plans had prescribed per-MT-labeled commits). Satisfies committed-reproducibility; per-MT diffs are not commit-bisectable (attributed by file/symbol). CONCERN, not a FAIL.
